pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid beside Budapest’s Great Market Hall, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and common spaces.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm beds, occupancy and cot needs. Individual dorm beds are different products. The communal guest kitchen can help families prepare meals; check house rules and available equipment.

The Csarnok tér property is beside the Great Market Hall on the Pest side, with public transport nearby. Compare the full private-room cost, taxes, breakfast, parking, luggage storage and late-checkout terms for your dates.

Review tradeoffs

Guests praise the market location and transport access, while recent accounts raise housekeeping, breakfast, room temperature and fee concerns. Read feedback for your room category and ask about seasonal cooling if heat matters. Tripadvisor component scores are a research snapshot rather than live ratings.

Opening and capacity

MEININGER’s later opening chronology records the Budapest launch on 18 March 2019. The earlier spring-2018 target is not used as an opening date.

The opening announcement reports 184 rooms and 751 beds in a seven-storey property. These are opening-era figures, not a claim that later inventory is unchanged. No property-specific construction investment was verified.

pin.longFormSummary:
A woodland holiday village in Bedfordshire, with family lodges, indoor swimming, play areas and bookable activities; compare accommodation types and extra charges.

Family lodges and activities

Choose the exact lodge type, bedroom layout, occupancy and any cot or accessibility needs. The village also opened with a hotel and spa suites; these are different accommodation products and should not be assumed to share a family lodge’s kitchen or occupancy.

The operator lists the Subtropical Swimming Paradise and indoor/outdoor play areas among included facilities. Many activities, cycle hire, restaurants and spa visits can add to the bill; check booking requirements, age rules, current prices and what your break includes. Pick a lodge location with walking distances and the site’s hills in mind.

Guest feedback

Guests praise the swimming complex, woodland setting and family activities. Recent reviews also describe expensive extras, variable lodge cleanliness, maintenance concerns and busy changeover days. These are guest accounts; read current reviews of your lodge type. The rubric covers the whole village, not only the separate hotel.

Opening and village development

First paying guests arrived on 6 June 2014, following an earlier trial break. The operator’s July 2014 investor presentation reports approximately £250 million in development cost for the whole village. This is not a nightly price or a hotel-only construction cost.

The launch release describes 625 lodges, a 75-bedroom hotel and six spa suites. These are opening-era capacities, separate from later additions or refurbishment. The pin represents the complete Woburn Forest village.
